pr_title: Prevent `LineEdit` focus loss when text is submitted or rejected and allow selecting without editing with arrow keys.
pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/87673

- Prevent focus loss when text is rejected by pressing `Escape`.
- [Editor] Prevent focus loss when a text property is submitted by pressing `Enter`.
- Allow exiting edit mode by pressing `Escape` to select other focusable `Control` nodes.
- Allow entering focus mode only without editing by entering focus with arrow keys, pressing `Enter` will toggle between select/edit modes and pressing `Escape` while editing will return back to select mode.
pr_comments:
<s>maybe we will need to add `void grab_focus_edit(bool select_all = false)` to focus the `LineEdit` in edit mode directly. because 36 files was changed to add a new line `LineEdit->set_focus_edit(true)` after `LineEdit->grab_focus()`. </s>

Ready for review! I think we should expose the 3 new functions.
You keep wiping your branch and closing the PR, I'd suggest making your changes and check the branch locally before pushing and causing such noise in the history 🙂

> You keep wiping your branch and closing the PR, I'd suggest making your changes and check the branch locally before pushing and causing such noise in the history 🙂

I was testing the changes and making it ready for review.
Sorry about the noise, the issues appeared while using the editor with the current changes and I was fixing them.

The SpinBox changes brought back #78079.

Overall it's a nice change, but the SpinBox bug should be fixed. Also the API is somewhat confusing. `grab_focus_edit()` can be renamed to `edit()`, `is_focus_edit()` can be renamed to `is_being_edited()`. I'm not sure what `set_focus_edit()` is supposed to do, though looks like the `set_focus_edit(true)` is redundant and the method can be called `unedit()`.

```
C:\godot_source\core/object/message_queue.cpp:223 - Error calling deferred method: 'LineEdit::LineEdit::edit': Method expected 1 arguments, but called with 0.
```
Since `edit()` takes an argument now, every `call_deferred()` needs to be fixed, because `callable_mp()` does not support default arguments.

EDIT:
You missed some LineEdits, they still use `grab_focus()`, which makes them not edited. Or at least one - in EditorPropertyNodePath.

Which made me realize that this breaks compatibility. I ignored it before, because you can just press Enter and still edit the LineEdit, but I think users who used `grab_edit()` to edit their controls will now be confused and might not realize that they need to press Enter. Not sure if it's worth handing, it would require a property to make the new behavior optional. Though defaulting to the old behavior would make the new one less discoverable, so idk.

EDIT2:
The API looks fine now, though I'd mention the "edit mode" in LineEdit's description.

> Which made me realize that this breaks compatibility. I ignored it before, because you can just press Enter and still edit the LineEdit, but I think users who used `grab_edit()` to edit their controls will now be confused and might not realize that they need to press Enter. Not sure if it's worth handing, it would require a property to make the new behavior optional. Though defaulting to the old behavior would make the new one less discoverable, so idk.

We can optionally return back the old behavior, but the main issue was the focus loss when pressing `escape`, also we can allow force editing when focused but this is also useless since the new changes will force editing when focused with `tab` or `shift + tab` by default but not the arrow keys. The best solution is to note the new changes in docs, using `edit()` will also grab focus if it's unfocused or not editable, all they need to do is to replace `grab_focus()` with `edit()` so we can also note this in the `grab_focus()` discription.

maybe we can enter edit mode directly for the first time when it's not focused with keyboard, and we exit back to focus mode when the escape key is pressed to avoid focus loss and to be able to select another GUI nodes with keyboard.
Makes sense I think. You can still use Tab to change focus in edit mode, though it's less convenient with arrows.
@WhalesState Looks like you erased your changes by mistake (I assume).

There was an issue while undoing the commit, it was reverting the branch publishing instead of the last commit.

Now with this changes, `LineEdit` will enter focus mode only when it's focused with arrow keys, using `grab_focus()` should work as expected.

This will only prevent focus loss, and will allow users to exist edit mode by pressing `Enter` or `Escape` to submit or reject the text and yet they will be able to focus other UI nodes.

This is an exception for arrow keys only or when Enter or Escape is pressed while editing.

`_edit()` and `_unedit()` are now private, in addition user can check if the `LineEdit` is being edited using `LineEdit.is_editing()` and to connect `editing_toggled` signal which will emit when editing is toggled instead of focus entered/exited, since we can't release focus now to avoid focus loss, similar to button and other UI elements.

This also can be applied to `TextEdit`, but to only exit editing mode by pressing escape and to not enter editing mode when it's focused with arrows.

@KoBeWi, Please let me know if any changes are required.


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/79e8ae51-db91-476b-ac52-7c8ebb29f612

> Tested basic functionality and it works great. I noticed some IME change that I'm not sure about; they need to be assessed.

We have to make sure that the old code is still the same.

Changes in this PR:
- `NOTIFICATION_FOCUS_ENTER` old code was moved to `_edit()`. 
- `NOTIFICATION_FOCUS_EXIT` old code was moved to `_unedit()`.
- `String.length() == 0` and `String.length() != 0` was changed to `String.is_empty()` and `!String.is_empty()` for readability.
- Removed redundant `queue_redraw()` calls.

issue_context.title: LineEdit and SpinBox focus issue
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

4.2.1

### System information

win 10

### Issue description

1 - when it's focused with keyboard, it immediately switch to edit mode instead of just selecting the line edit, so the only way to select the next focusable `CanvasItem` is by pressing Tab.
2 - if the `LineEdit` is focused and escape button is pressed, the focus is lost! and it's impossible to focus any `CanvasItem` again with the keyboard until we focus one of them with mouse click . [ Editor and Game ]

### Steps to reproduce

N/A

N/A
